doc: The violations an S438 can be written for.
A STARTER SET, not the authoritative list. The SCDPS publishes no machine-readable violation code list
with the S438, so these are the Title 56 sections the ticket is most often written under, and both the
point values and the court-appearance flags need checking against the current Code before an agency
